scripts.env:setup: wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin activate woocommerce sample-shelf-for-woocommerce && wp-env run tests-cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/sample-shelf-for-woocommerce/tests/e2e/seed.php
scripts.env:reset: wp-env clean tests && npm run env:setup
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin check sample-shelf-for-woocommerce --exclude-directories=tests,node_modules,vendor
